versions.content: Modeling of a Variable-Size Array Data Type only with ImplementationDataType The modeling of a Variable-Size Array Data Type does not require the existence of an ApplicationComposite- DataType and a DataTypeMap . A Variable-Size Array Data Type can be created by just setting up an ImplementationDataType .
